get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Our client in Namur, Belgium is looking for a Business Intelligence Specialist / BI Analyst Developer with strong experience in Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS and Power BI.
 

You will maintain and enhance existing Business Intelligence solutions while developing new reporting, data integration and analytics capabilities. Working within an established BI team, you will contribute to ETL development, data modelling, OLAP solutions, dashboards and decision-support systems, supporting business reporting and monitoring requirements.
 

Location and set-up: Namur, Belgium. Hybrid: 50% remote and 50% on-site. Contract (contractor). Fluent French and English required. European candidates are welcome to apply, but need to relocate to Namur. Applicants must have the right to work in Belgium, as a work permit is not provided.
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 
 

• Analyse business requirements and design, develop and maintain Business Intelligence solutions that meet functional and technical specifications. 

• Develop reporting solutions, interactive dashboards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) using data from operational databases. 

• Design, develop and maintain ETL processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), ensuring reliable data extraction, transformation and loading. 

• Develop and maintain OLAP and multidimensional data solutions using SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS). 

• Create and maintain reports and visualisations using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Power BI. 

• Design and optimise data models, including Star Schema and Snowflake Schema, and contribute to data architecture and modelling standards. 

• Produce technical analyses, data models, documentation and user guides while supporting knowledge transfer, training and end-user assistance. 

• Collaborate with the BI team to improve existing solutions, data integration processes and application architecture.  

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree. 

• 3+ years of professional experience in each of the following areas: BI data modelling (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema); ETL development (Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, SSIS); OLAP (Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services, SSAS); reporting and visualisation (SQL Server Reporting Services, SSRS, and Power BI); databases (SQL Server 2019 or later and multidimensional databases). 

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server database structures, data integration and reporting architectures. 

• Experience analysing functional and non-functional requirements and translating them into effective BI solutions. 

• Ability to interpret database schemas, develop technical documentation and support BI users. 

• Understanding of data modelling, semantic representation and data quality principles.
